title: A mass hanging from two strings
caption: In equilibrium the forces sum to zero. Horizontal: T₁ cos 30° = T₂ cos 60°, so T₂ = √3 T₁. Vertical: T₁ sin 30° + T₂ sin 60° = 19.6 N, so T₁ = 9.8 N and T₂ ≈ 17 N.
alt: Free-body diagram of the 2 kilogram mass: weight 19.6 newtons down, tension 9.8 newtons up and left at 30 degrees, tension 17.0 newtons up and right at 60 degrees, net zero.
description: T₁ = 9.8 N at 30° above the horizontal, to the left.
T₂ = 16.97 N at 60° above the horizontal, to the right.
Horizontal: 8.49 N each way. Vertical: 19.6 N up = weight.
